1. Jane bought 40 eggs on May 9th, 2017.
2. She ate one egg per day.
3. Therefore, she would have run out of eggs after 40 days.

To find the end date:
- From May 9th to June 8th is exactly 40 days (including both start and end dates).

So, starting from May 9th, adding 40 days leads us to June 8th, 2017. This matches option (A) in the provided choices: 06/08/2017.
